demo_description: A financially coherent salaried professional with everything the analysis needs: stable income, essential spending well below income, easy-access savings above the emergency target, a regular monthly investment, a full questionnaire and three realistic goals. The application takes it through the whole pipeline to an approved recommendation with a portfolio, a compliance pass and an explanation -- every one of those results is computed, none is stored here.
expected_demo_flow: Use Individual Demo login > Dashboard > Risk Assessment > Financial Health > Goals > Portfolio > Recommendation > Why This Recommendation (Simple and Detailed) > Scenario Simulator > Agent Activity
notes: Individual demo persona; in no household. The AGG weight is copied exactly as stored (a floating-point value of about 1.7e-16), which the application displays as 0%.

demo_description: A salaried customer in a dual-income family whose easy-access savings cover only about two and a half months of essential spending, against a six-month emergency target. All the information is complete, so the analysis runs end to end and the existing emergency-fund rule steers it to a savings-first recommendation instead of an investment portfolio. The inputs cause that behaviour; nothing here states it. Primary member of the family household.
expected_demo_flow: Use Family Demo login (resolves to this customer) > Customer Profile with the Household section open > members / records / financial summary / household goals > own pages show savings first with no portfolio weights
notes: Also the primary (self) of the family household. The household columns describe the household and are repeated on each member row - they are not this customer's own figures and never enter the individual analysis.

demo_description: A senior professional with a solid income, a monthly investment plan and goals, who has not yet told the application their monthly essential spending or easy-access savings. The risk and goal steps run, but the compliance step cannot confirm the emergency-fund rule, and that existing rule is binding and fails closed: the real compliance engine returns REJECT, so no recommendation or explanation is produced. No rule was added or changed -- an unknown emergency-fund position is never treated as sufficient. Spouse member of the family household.
expected_demo_flow: No in-app login (one customer per session, no switcher): shown through the API docs (/docs) - GET /api/profiles/lookup by name, then GET /api/analysis/{analysis_id} - compliance REJECT; appears in the family view as the spouse (identity only)
notes: Also the spouse (member) of the family household. Monthly essential spending and easy-access savings are deliberately not provided, so the emergency fund is unknown and the compliance gate rejects fail-closed; the savings plan is provided, so goal feasibility is still computed.

demo_description: A new customer who has shared a complete profile, spending, savings and goals, and has answered the first part of the questionnaire, but has no investment trading history and has not answered the risk-tolerance questions. The risk model has nothing to classify, so the existing pipeline stops at its low-confidence branch and asks for more information; compliance, portfolio, recommendation and explanation are never produced. The pending state is the real outcome of that missing input.
expected_demo_flow: No in-app login while the Complete persona is seeded: shown through the API docs (/docs) - analysis status pending_information with nothing downstream
notes: Canonical pending-information customer (lowest id with this name). The questionnaire is intentionally partly answered and there is no trading history.
